import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check server build only
print("=== Building server only ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria_new && pnpm --filter @wasd/server build 2>&1 | tail -20")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# If server builds, try to start it
print("\n=== Starting server ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria_new/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 8 && pm2 list")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Health check
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
